metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/ replays the validated Sharpa Wave episode on the Marvin right arm (1,159 controls, success after 1,009); it passes two fresh-process replays with identical state hashes, float32 rounding, and the Harbor oracle in both modes (standard: the same rows submitted through the public client).

notes.layout: Each row starts with the 14 Marvin arm joint targets (left arm J1-J7, then right arm J1-J7), followed by the left hand's finger targets and then the right hand's (22 per hand for `sharpa`, 20 per hand for `wuji`); the left arm is parked and only the right arm/hand perform the task.
